This is a rule that agents know and skip under pressure, so I'll use the prohibition form:
- a rule that closes the loopholes explicitly, including the "run it after tagging" ordering and the "spirit over letter" argument
- a rationalization table built from the verbatim excuses
- a red-flags list
- the description updated with violation symptoms (triggers only, no workflow summary)

After the edit I'll re-run the same three scenarios, 5 reps each, with the hardened skill loaded. I'll report the result against the baseline of 9 skips in 15 runs, and add counters for any new rationalizations that show up.
